title: Week in Orbit
summary: The space industry is grappling with access bottlenecks for small satellites while defense budgets swell to bolster space resilience. Meanwhile, the specter of jamming and spoofing looms large as stakeholders scramble for solutions.

themes.title: Small Sat Access Issues
themes.body: Small satellite operators are facing significant hurdles in accessing space, raising questions about the sustainability of current launch capacities. This bottleneck could stifle innovation and growth in the sector if not addressed promptly.

themes.title: Defense Budgets on the Rise
themes.body: The House Appropriations Committee's approval of $55.5 billion for the Space Force signals a robust commitment to national security in space. An additional $1.4 billion earmarked for space resilience in the FY27 budget further underscores this trend.

themes.title: Countering Jamming Threats
themes.body: As GPS jamming incidents resurface, the industry is under pressure to develop effective countermeasures against these disruptions. This ongoing challenge highlights the critical need for enhanced security protocols in space operations.

themes.title: New Collaborations Emerge
themes.body: Anduril and L3Harris are teaming up on a tactical SDA constellation bid, reflecting a growing trend of partnerships aimed at enhancing space capabilities. Such collaborations may be pivotal in addressing the complex demands of modern defense.
